resources.string: In Accessibility Settings, open Downloaded apps or Installed services, select Screenly, and turn on Use Screenly. Return here to check the status.

After enabling the service, open Android Settings. Tap the floating Screenly bubble, then Guide Me, to select an enabled, clickable element for highlighting. Drag and release the bubble to dock it to the nearest side at your chosen height. The highlight allows taps through and clears when the target screen changes. Debug builds still print elements and screen coordinates to Logcat with the tag ScreenlyAccessibility.

Screen observations are temporary; passwords and sensitive nodes are excluded. Your recent chat and guide instructions are saved privately on this device for follow-up use until you clear them in Privacy or uninstall the app. Screen images are not saved or uploaded. Screenly never taps for you.
